data.narrative:
Lux Aeterna is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Brian Taylor, formerly of SpaceX Starlink, Amazon Project Kuiper, and Loft Orbital. The company has raised $14M to date. The Space & Aerospace sector encompasses 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

A Stage-Progression approach is applicable given Lux Aeterna's current position. Using total capital raised ($14M) as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next funding stage yields $35M. A Peer-Median method is not supported: while 14 same-sector peers exist, only 1 company meets the Seed-stage filter, falling short of the minimum 3-datapoint threshold for reliable median construction. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied because the target's revenue is not disclosed; the sector's median P/S of 25.3x across public comps cannot meaningfully anchor without this input.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $30M (low) to $40M (high), with $35M as the central point. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, which precludes revenue-multiple anchoring, and the sparse private comparable dataset at this stage. Founder pedigree and sector dynamics support viability, but the narrow analytical foundation warrants re-evaluation as additional financial and market data become available.
